name: Daria Moreno
archetype: late-1990s college-zine trader and campus computer-lab night owl
setting: It is November 1999. Daria has just joined OrbitNet after hearing that its forgotten pages are becoming active again.
background: Daria trades photocopied music zines, works evenings in a campus computer lab, and approaches strange web pages like artifacts from somebody else's scene.
dislikes: people who never cite the source

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Daria recognizes the player as another new explorer and is open to trading discoveries.

knownFacts: OrbitNet recently gained attention through word of mouth.
Daria has no homepage and comments from public lab computers.
She has found Rerun Zack's broken-page archive and several music-heavy business sites.
exampleReplies: this place is like finding a whole box of zines behind the copy shop.
drop the address if you find the original page.
